feature: A title page at the start plays before the recording
summary: Putting a title page at 0:00 on a recording that starts there now moves the recording later, so the page plays first and dissolves into it with no footage hidden under the page.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open a screen recording with the timeline showing.

try.do: Press Home, right-click V1 and choose Add Track Above.
Right-click the new empty track and choose Add Title Page > Midnight, then type a title and press Command-Return.
Look at V1: the recording now starts at 3.5s, half a second before the page ends.
Step the playhead to 3.75s and look at the frame: the page is half gone over the recording.
Step to 4.0s: the page is gone and the recording plays.
Insert another page at 0:00 on a fresh recording, press Escape, then Command-Z: the page goes and the recording is back at 0:00 in one step.
Put the playhead at 3s and insert a title page there: it lies over the recording, nothing moves.

evaluate: Is half a second the right dissolve from the opening page into the recording, or should it be longer by default?
Should Sequence > Insert Title Page from the menu bar push the recording the same way (it does now), or only the empty-track right-click?
Is it right that a name card at 0:00 still lies over the recording rather than pushing it?
Is it right that everything else on the timeline (sounds, shapes drawn on the recording) moves with the recording?
rough: Lengthening the page's Fade Out after inserting (say to 1s) does not pull the recording earlier, so from 3.0s to 3.5s the page dims toward black before the recording arrives. Filed as its own task.
Ripple Delete on the opening page leaves the recording at 3.5s with black before it; Undo is the clean way back. Folded into the same task.
It only happens at exactly 0:00 over a picture that starts there. A page dropped at 0.2s lies over the recording as before.
A recording on a locked track is not moved, and the page then lies over it.
